turns.input: Captain Doran Hale gives Nicco a pair of leather boots.
turns.narration: Captain Doran Hale draws the pair of leather boots from his belt and extends them toward Nicco. "These should serve you better than whatever you're wearing now. The streets here are hard on soles, and I've seen too many men slow themselves down with poor footing." His blue eyes hold steady, veteran scars catching the daylight as he waits for Nicco's hand to meet his.

turns.input:
Thanks *he said to them, after which he decides to give them back the boots*
You'll need them more than me
turns.narration:
"Thanks," Nicco said, and held the boots back out toward the captain. "You'll need them more than me."

Doran Hale regarded the returned boots with a moment's stillness, his blue eyes narrowing slightly in assessment. Then he accepted them, tucking them under one arm with a short nod. "Your choice," he said. "But don't come limping to my post expecting sympathy when your feet blister." There was no particular edge to it—practical observation offered plain, the way one soldier might warn another. He glanced past Nicco toward Heartstone's massive entrance, then back at the man standing before it. "If you're set on being stubborn, so be it. Decisions have consequences. Make sure yours are informed ones."
